verdict.rationale: Antigravity's first-party docs cover custom skills across the desktop app, CLI and SDK. Developers can create or download fully customizable skills, defined as folders containing a SKILL.md with task-specific instructions. Skills can also be bundled into plugins, managed via CLI slash commands, and layered into the Agent SDK. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom skills work as described.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks

citations.quote: Create or download fully customizable skills to further your agent’s autonomy and transform how you get work done.
A skill is a folder containing a `SKILL.md` file with instructions that the agent can follow when working on specific tasks.
Skills are reusable packages of knowledge that extend what the agent can do.
Plugins are namespaced bundles that allow you to extend Antigravity’s capabilities by grouping skills, rules, MCP servers, and hooks into a single package.
Layer custom Python callables, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and reusable agent skills over our built-in filesystem and terminal tools under a single pipeline.
